text:
Priya: quick heads-upi'm doing a small refresh of the hello-world quickstart. goal: reduce friction for first deploy and clarify auth options. linking draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4399
Owen: nice. what are the main UX changes?
Priya: 1) add a 'Before you start' checklist (env vars + region + smallest required role) 2) swap the long-lived API key example with ephemeral token for the browser flow 3) add a tiny troubleshooting section for common deploy failures
Lina: we should be careful about implying ephemeral tokens are fine for production. add a single-sentence caveat and link to the security guide.
Priya: yep planning a one-line caveat: "For production/private deployments, use KMS-backed JWTs or server-signed tokens (see /guides/security)."
marco: CI reports a broken anchor in the troubleshooting section - the anchor `#deploy-errors` doesn't exist on the deploy page.
ci-bot: link-checker: 1 broken link -> /deploy#deploy-errors (404)
Priya: thanks. i'll update the anchor to /deploy#troubleshooting and push.
Owen: for the code snippet, please use the SDK v8.1 example. example proposed:
```js
// pinned to @redwood/sdk@^8.1.0
const ephemeral = await client.auth.getEphemeralToken({ ttlSeconds: 60 })
await fetch('/api/start', { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${ephemeral}` } })
```
Lina: small wording nit: change "ttlSeconds" to "ttl" in the snippet then add a parenthetical: (seconds). readers skim quickly.
marco: also lint complains about an unused import in the sample app (import fetch from 'node-fetch' but not used). either remove or use a minimal fetch example.
Priya: i'll remove the unnecessary import.
Owen: can we also add a one-line note to set PROJECT_REGION or the deploy script will error silently? this has bitten a few new devs.
Priya: good calladding a "Before you start" bullet for PROJECT_REGION + REDWOOD_TOKEN.
Lina: screenshot update request: previous screen still showed the old env var name REDWOOD_API_KEY. update to REDWOOD_TOKEN and regenerate.
Priya: will capture a fresh screenshot after the other fixes.
marco: recommend adding a tiny section "If you see an auth 401" with two quick checks: clock skew on the local machine and expired ephemeral token. keeps support prio down.
Priya: done in draft.
ci-bot: build: docs-build passed; link-checker re-run: 0 broken links.
Owen: looks great. once you regenerate the screenshot and fix lint i'll give final LGTM.
Priya: pushing screenshot + lint fix now. thanks all for the quick feedback :rocket:
